verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents a self-hosted Edge Proxy that runs the Flagsmith Engine inside your own infrastructure, and server-side SDKs connect to it, so SDK traffic stays on your network. The evidence does not say the proxy keeps serving flags when Flagsmith's hosted service is unreachable, which is half of the story. missing for 10: documented behaviour when the vendor is unreachable (caching, offline serving, failover), client-side SDK support via the proxy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can run a relay/edge proxy so flags stay served when the vendor is unreachable and SDK traffic stays inside my network

citations.quote: The Flagsmith Edge Proxy is a service that you host yourself, that allows you to run an instance of the Flagsmith Engine close to your servers.
Run the Edge Proxy within in your own infrastructure and connect to it from your server-side SDKs
